<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Agadir Concept — Univers de design
 * Description: Recovery patcher for ACDU 4.1.0.
 * Version: 4.1.0-recovery
 */
defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;
$file = plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) . 'includes/elementor/class-home-widgets.php';
if ( is_readable( $file ) && is_writable( $file ) ) {
    $code = (string) file_get_contents( $file );
    $code = str_replace( 'private function render_button(', 'protected function render_button(', $code );
    $code = str_replace( 'private function asset(', 'protected function asset(', $code );
    file_put_contents( $file, $code, LOCK_EX );
    if ( function_exists( 'opcache_invalidate' ) ) {
        @opcache_invalidate( $file, true );
    }
}
